objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (Level 1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the document within the status network (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time period for validity check, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration the document is archived before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: The original language in which the document was created.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of in which clients the document is visible in a multi-client system.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to master data, other documents, IT applications, relevant companies or areas of validity.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning but released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document supplement that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and has no own release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is released and published via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by any author to request changes to a released document, without affecting the document content or version history directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled for implementation, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, triggering the override (out-of-force) process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, created only by Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning authorizations (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group.

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can hold roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the person (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons maintained per document who are informed about releases, either by email or for acknowledgement.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the template.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: A configurable classification defining the kind of document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: type_name
attributes.description: Name of the document type.

attributes.name: type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation used in document naming.

attributes.name: default_validity_period
attributes.description: Default period of extended validity for this type.

attributes.name: default_archive_duration
attributes.description: Default archive duration for this type.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow step.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: Person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Time at which the signature was provided.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Workflow step associated with the signature (Creator, Review, Release).

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: A task assigned to a participant within a workflow process, requiring action such as signing, reviewing, or approving.

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: Type of the workflow task (Creator sign, Review, Release, Acknowledgement, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Translation).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the task (pending, completed, rejected).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The selected document type for the new document.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The selected template, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of the document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of the document are maintained or changed via the properties editing dialog.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: The property category being edited (e.g. Master Data, Control).

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format by the system.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review task, either positively or with rejection.

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: Outcome of the review (approved or rejected).

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release task, either positively or with rejection.

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: Outcome of the release (approved or rejected).

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: A rejection during review or release cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The step at which rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or change proposal scheduling.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for version creation (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is created for a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document without affecting the main document version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is deleted directly from a document without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, which creates a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal; the creator is notified by email.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: The validity extension request is processed through a workflow by releasers (and optionally author and reviewer).

attributes.name: process_variant
attributes.description: Which process variant is used (releaser only, or author-reviewer-releaser).

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The document validity is extended, the Valid Until date is updated, and the validity extension request is deleted.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A request for override (out-of-force) is created for a document that has no additional validity.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: The override request is processed through a workflow (by releasers only, or by initiator-reviewer-releaser).

attributes.name: process_variant
attributes.description: Which process variant is used (releaser only, or initiator-reviewer-releaser).

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force; last valid version is given Out of Force status, all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group for an invalidated document.

evts.name: process_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is processed by the initiator, resulting in a new version of the document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated with a new version, restoring authorizations and distribution list.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read or write).

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email notification to involved users about workflow status, tasks, or document events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (workflow task, validity extension, override, change proposal, distribution, acknowledgement).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, the archived documents are physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to a main Document and is released together with it.
Additional Info is supplementary to a Document without affecting its release cycle.
A Change Proposal belongs to a specific Document and is displayed within it.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
A Request for Override is created for a specific Document to invalidate it.
A Request for Reactivation references the invalidated Document to be reactivated.
A Document belongs to a specific Document Type that defines its classification and defaults.
One or more Document Templates can be defined for each Document Type.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document for notification and acknowledgement.
A Distribution List can contain User Groups to be notified.
A Distribution List can contain individual Persons to be notified.
A Document is associated with Persons in roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translator.
A Document is associated with User Groups for reader authorization and other group-based permissions.
A User Group contains Persons who are members of that group.
An Electronic Signature is provided by a specific Person.

o2e.description: A Document is created during the Create Document event.
A Document's content is modified during the Edit Document Content event.
A Document's properties are maintained during the Edit Document Properties event.
A Document is converted to PDF format during the Convert to PDF event.
The release workflow is started for a Document.
The author signs the Document in the creator step.
A Person (author) signs during the Creator step.
An Electronic Signature is created during the Creator step.
A Document is reviewed during the review step.
A Person (reviewer) completes the review step.
An Electronic Signature is created during the review step.
A Document is approved or rejected during the release step.
A Person (releaser) completes the release step.
An Electronic Signature is created during the release step.
A Document's workflow is canceled due to rejection.
A Document is published after release.
A new version is created for a Document.
An Attachment is created during this event.
The main Document is affected when an Attachment is created.
An Attachment is modified during this event.
The main Document is affected when an Attachment is modified.
An Attachment is marked for archiving during this event.
The main Document is affected when an Attachment is archived.
Additional Info is created during this event.
Additional Info is added to a Document.
Additional Info is deleted during this event.
A Change Proposal is created during this event.
A Change Proposal is created for a specific Document.
A Person with author rights creates the Change Proposal.
A Change Proposal is scheduled for implementation.
A new Document version is created when a Change Proposal is scheduled.
A Change Proposal is completed by the author.
A Request for Validity Extension is created by the system.
The system creates a validity extension request for a Document.
A Request for Validity Extension is processed through a workflow.
A Document's validity is extended.
The Request for Validity Extension is deleted upon extension.
A Request for Override is created for a Document.
An override request is created for a specific Document.
A Request for Override is processed through a workflow.
A Document is declared out of force.
A Request for Reactivation is created.
A reactivation request references a specific Document.
A Request for Reactivation is processed through a workflow.
A Document is reactivated with a new version.
Authorizations are assigned to a Document.
A User Group is assigned authorization on a Document.
A Person is assigned authorization on a Document.
A Document is distributed by email to users on its distribution list.
The Distribution List determines recipients of email distribution.
A Document is distributed for acknowledgement to users on its distribution list.
The Distribution List determines recipients for acknowledgement.
Acknowledgement is confirmed for a specific Document.
A Person confirms acknowledgement of a Document.
An email notification is sent regarding a Document.
A Person receives an email notification.
A Document is translated into another language.
A Person (translator) translates the Document.
A translated Document version is released through a workflow.
A Document is physically deleted after the archive period expires.
